81. Let f be a function that is twice differentiable on -2 < x < 2 and satisfies the conditions in the table above. If
f(x) = f(-x), what are the x-coordinates of the points of inflection of the graph of f on -2 < x < 2 ?
(A) x = 0 only
(B) x = 1 only
(C) x = 0 and x = 1
(D) x = -1 and x = 1
(E)There are no points of inflection on -2 < x < 2.
